notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later; uses the selected account context. No request arguments or defaults are declared in the pinned operation.
Returns the server SSH port as an optional integer; no numeric-string coercion is inferred. Reading the port does not connect to SSH or establish SSH availability.
Available in cPanel 11.42 and later; uses the selected account context. No request arguments or defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

Returns optional boolean has_terminal_access and optional string shell for the selected account. Preserve false and empty strings separately from omission; integer 0/1 flags are not booleans for this response. This read does not open a shell or establish successful SSH authentication.
